connector.name: Sports Card Agent
connector.registryDescription: Sports card pricing, market analysis, grading ROI, and player stats (NBA/NFL/MLB)
connector.summary: Runs locally from the Python package sports-card-agent. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the rjexile account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.
